proof.note: A signed-in Chromium session walked the landing page, server list, overview, module settings, analytics, activity, directory, config and drift, templates, fleet, API tokens, webhooks, instance, 404 at 1280px and 390px (the 405 method path was exercised by request and a regression test) over Postgres and a real Discord OAuth session. The run found the legacy pages still emitting an undefined .panel class, a guild chip whose two spans shared one line, analytics source labels colliding with their bars, and a root "General" fieldset around every setting; all four were fixed in the stylesheet or renderer and re-checked. No dashboard console errors and no Discord 429 appeared on the final pass.
